Name: Jekk's Dinos for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Need more dinos? Of course you do! With permission from jekkbenavu I've updated and rewritten [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5073]Jekks Dinosaur Re-Skin[/url] to work as a standalone mod to add more dinos to your game!  

This mod adds a lil brontosaurus! It comes in 3 colors and lives in coops. They can be purchased from Marnie. They produce ancient seeds and dino eggs a little faster than vanilla dinos. And they roar!

Enjoy!
